seo.title: Alerts for the Branch That Needs Attention | SAAYT
seo.description: Get alerted to low ratings · unanswered reviews or changed branch details on Google so you know exactly where to step in first

h1: Know which branch needs you before it grows
lead: Instead of opening every branch to check, SAAYT lines up what needs attention today: a low rating, an unanswered review or details that changed on Google

items.d: Checking each one every day is work nobody keeps up with
On Google any user can suggest changes to business details and sometimes something changes without you noticing
An alert the same day beats finding the problem a week later
One or two stars and you get an alert with the branch name
A reminder after a time you set if nobody has replied
An alert when the phone, address or hours change on a branch profile
The most important first so you know where to start
Branch alerts go to the branch manager and the summary goes to management
The status of every branch in one message each week

steps.d: Reviews and details of connected branches
A clear alert to the person responsible
Reply or correct details in one tap

guard.d: Choose what reaches you and when and switch off any alert type

faq.a: Inside the SAAYT dashboard and by email and you decide who receives each type

faq.a: Yes. Set the time that suits your team
